collection.description: A child is confused when two respected teachers disagree about a strange light.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (child) is confused when two respected teachers disagree about a strange light.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: (child) learns to ask what each teacher actually observed.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: (child) notices that neither teacher has enough evidence yet.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: (child) finds parts of each account interesting.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: (child) decides to wait before choosing an explanation.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: (adult), a caregiver, shows how to question an idea without insulting a person.

d1.name: Outcome D1
d1.text: (child) watches the sky on another evening.

d2.name: Outcome D2
d2.text: Nothing unusual appears, leaving the mystery open.
